    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.

    k = 10.0 / (bins.max() + 1e-9)

    tie_break = bins / (10.0 * bins.max() + 1e-9)
    priority_scores = sigmoid_scores + tie_break
    return priority_scores
